name: syncproof — check a sheet somebody else's pipeline builds

nodes.name: When clicking 'Execute workflow'
nodes.notes: Lets the workflow be run by hand or headlessly (n8n execute --id ...) as well as on the schedule.

nodes.name: Ask syncproof to verify
nodes.notes: HTTP rather than an Execute Command node, deliberately. In n8n 2.x that node is disabled by default, and once enabled it returned empty stdout on this build — a command's output cannot be read reliably. HTTP works the same on self-hosted and Cloud.

nodes.name: Trustworthy?
nodes.notes: 200 = the sheet matches the export. 422 = it does not.
